# haneoka

> Unofficial BanG Dream! Our Notes database. Read public character profiles, cards, songs, events, gacha and stories in Markdown.

Each document gives the canonical web address. Start with a catalog to find individual entries.

- [English](https://siriustrack.site/jp/en/llms.txt)
- [日本語](https://siriustrack.site/jp/ja/llms.txt)
- [한국어](https://siriustrack.site/jp/ko/llms.txt)
- [中文（中国）](https://siriustrack.site/jp/zh-CN/llms.txt)
- [中文（台灣）](https://siriustrack.site/jp/zh-TW/llms.txt)
